reuse.why: Uses the tree's single weekend definition applyWeekendRule exactly as getUpcomingDates does, plus recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, parseDate/dayFromDate and captureBreadcrumb.

duplication.why: No weekend or occurrence logic is restated; the only shared shape with getUpcomingDates is the thin RSchedule + try/captureBreadcrumb wrapper.

placement.why: The handler lives next to get-upcoming-dates in server/schedules/app.ts and leaves the weekend rule in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Handler, registration, a test and a release note only.

maintainability.why: Short and clear, with the ±2-day window explained; the daily-schedule exception from the request is not represented anywhere, so it would have to be added to the shared rule later.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Calls applyWeekendRule, the tree's single definition of the weekend rule.
